about: I am a photographer working from a small studio in {city}. Most of my pictures are of places in the hour after everyone has left.
I work slowly, usually with one camera and one lens, and print everything myself in the back room. A picture is finished when I can look at it for a week without wanting to change it.
In recent years my work has been shown in small galleries and libraries around the region and sold as prints to people who wanted something quiet for a wall.

about: I am an illustrator and printmaker. I draw for picture books, for magazines that still pay on time, and for anyone who needs a bird in the corner of a poster.
Most of my work begins as a pencil sketch in a notebook and ends as a linocut or a flat-colour digital drawing, whichever the job seems to want.
I live in {city} with a cat who has opinions about my compositions.

about: We are a small design studio in {city}. We work with theatres, shops, charities and the occasional brewery, mostly on identities and printed matter.
We like clear grids, honest paper and typefaces that have been around long enough to behave. We try not to make anything that needs a tutorial.
Most projects start with a conversation and a cup of tea, and finish with a box of printed samples on the table.
